title: Reinforcing pomelo peel pectin beads with L-glutamate-modified graphene oxide for high-stability BOD biosensing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20498-20513
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00695G, Paper
Open Access

Boi An Tran, Vy Thi Tuong Nguyen, Ngoc Xuan Nguyen, Thi-Kim-Chi Huynh, Thanh-Linh Huynh Duong, Thanh-Quang Le, Hoang-Duy Nguyen, Thi-Kim-Dung Hoang
In this study, we report the green modification of graphene oxide (GO) with 2-aminopentanedioic acid (L-glutamic acid, Glu) to enhance the mechanical stability and biocompatibility of pectin-based hydrogel beads for biosensor applications.
